Read denials are the point, not a bonus: sibling CLAUDE.md files are pulled in ON DEMAND when Claude reads into that directory, so isolation is a consequence of not reaching across rather than a loader guarantee. Paths are CWD-relative and assume the session started in this directory, which is S8's habit.
